title: Umujyi Wazimiye w'Ubuhanga Budasanzwe
intro: Umuco ukomeye wahoze wiganje mu bice binini by'isi, uzwiho inyubako ndende zageraga mu kirere. Nyamara munsi y'ubu bwiza, habayeho guhakana gukomeye - kwanga kumvira umuburo w'Imana woherejwe uturutse mu muryango ubwawo. Ubwibone n'ubwibone byahitaga bitanga igihano nk'icyo isi cyangwa ijuru bitari byarigeze bibona.
clues: Twigeze gutegeka isi nini cyane, twirata imbaraga twizeraga ko nta yindi mico yadusanisha.
Ubwami bwacu bwari buzwiho inyubako ndende zifite inkingi zikomeye zari zihagaze neza mu bihugu byose bizwi.
Umuburo wo mu muryango wacu warahagurutse, ashishikariza buri wese muri twe kugandukira Umuremyi umwe rukumbi.
Twahakanye ubutumwa twahawe kandi twanze kureka inzira twari twarazwe.
Umuyaga ukaze kandi ukaze cyane waraduturutseho, utuma tubura ubwirinzi na gato.
Twasigaye tumeze nk'ibiti by'imikindo bifite ubuvumo, dutatanye kandi twibagiranye, nk'isomo ku bantu bose bazakurikiraho.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Imvura y'amabuye y'ibumba yaka iturutse hejuru
Induru imwe iteye ubwoba iturutse mu ijuru

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Inkuge nini y'ibiti yubatswe ku musozi
Ingamiya y'ingore yavuye mu ibuye mu buryo bw'igitangaza
Umusozi wa Sinayi aho amategeko y'Imana yamanukiye
Ingoro y'ikirahure n'ibirahuri byiza ireba amazi atemba

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Basigaye nk'ibiti by'imikindo bifite ubuvumo, bitatanye kandi nta buzima
Yarohamye munsi y'imiraba ikomeye y'umwuzure ukomeye
Yakoreshejwe n'ijwi rimwe ry'agahinda ryinjira mu mutima
outcome.answer: Basigaye nk'ibiti by'imikindo bifite ubuvumo, bitatanye kandi nta buzima
